title: Product User Research, Intern
description: About Sarvam AISarvam AI is building India's sovereign AI stack, spanning foundational models, infrastructure and applications. Our mission is to make powerful AI accessible and useful for India, building technology that works across languages, industries and real-world use cases.As we continue to build and scale our products, understanding how people interact with them becomes increasingly important. We're looking for a curious and research-oriented intern to help us understand our users better and shape the experiences we build.The RoleAs a Product User Research Intern, you'll work closely with our product, design and engineering teams to understand user behaviour, identify friction points and uncover opportunities to improve our products.You'll interact directly with developers, product managers and founders, study how they use Sarvam's products, and translate your findings into actionable insights that influence product and design decisions.This is an opportunity to work on a new user research function at Sarvam, helping establish research practices and processes from the ground up. You'll also get ownership of a primary product area and the opportunity to see your research translate into real product improvements.What You'll Work OnUnderstand our users: Conduct user interviews, surveys and usability studies with developers, PMs and founders to understand their needs, behaviours and challenges. Improve product experiences: Research user journeys across Sarvam's developer console, playground, API documentation and applications. Identify friction points across onboarding, API key creation, first API calls, billing and other key workflows. Study developer journeys: Analyse the developer funnel, from sign-up to making the first API call and eventually becoming a paying user. Understand where users drop off and, more importantly, why. Test and evaluate designs: Conduct usability testing on existing interfaces and new prototypes, run preference and A/B tests, and benchmark experiences against other developer products. Turn research into insights: Analyse qualitative and quantitative data, identify patterns and present clear recommendations to product, design, growth and support teams. Build the research practice: Help establish research playbooks, interview templates, participant recruitment processes and a research repository that can scale with the team. What We're Looking ForStrong curiosity about user behaviour and a genuine interest in understanding why people use products the way they do. Comfortable speaking with users, conducting interviews and asking thoughtful, unbiased questions. Technical fluency — you should be comfortable reading API documentation, making basic API calls using tools like Postman, curl or Python, and understanding what might have gone wrong when an API fails. Comfortable working with data, analysing spreadsheets and interpreting product funnels or dashboards. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate research findings into clear insights and recommendations. Familiarity with AI tools and developer products, and an interest in exploring how they can improve research workflows. Good to HaveExperience with SQL or product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or Metabase. Familiarity with user research methodologies, usability testing and survey design. Experience reviewing Figma prototypes or conducting user interviews. Previous research projects, internships or personal projects involving products you've built or shipped. Fluency in one or more Indian languages. Who Can Apply?Final-year students or graduates who have completed their studies within the last 12 months. Candidates from engineering, psychology, economics, design or social science backgrounds. Individuals who can commit to a full-time, 6-month, in-office internship in Bengaluru. What You'll GetThe opportunity to help build Sarvam's user research function from the ground up. Direct exposure to product, design and engineering teams working on India's sovereign AI ecosystem. Hands-on experience researching developer products and real-world AI applications. Ownership of meaningful research projects with findings that directly influence product decisions. An opportunity to work closely with experienced product leaders and learn how research translates into better products. Potential for a pre-placement offer (PPO) based on performance.

**About The Role**
Delivery Performance is building AI agents that support delivery teams, including agents that help write Epics and Features to the required quality standard and agents that help teams prepare for stage gates. Each agent is only as valuable as the way people actually use it. This role provides continuous user research across these agents, so the team always knows how people use them, where they struggle, whether the agents improve the work they are meant to support, and what should change.
  
  
Success in this role means agent owners make decisions about their agents from evidence of real use, and can see whether the changes they made have worked.
  
  
You will work with the Delivery Management System team, Delivery Leads, Programme and Project Managers, and the squads who use the agents day to day.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Research planning**

* Agree with each agent owner, before every round of research, the question the round needs to answer and the decision it will inform.
* Decide where research time is spent based on where the biggest unknowns and risks are, so effort goes where it is most needed and is not spread evenly across agents.

**Continuous user research**

* Plan and run a continuous cycle of usability testing across every live and upcoming agent, so that each agent is tested with the people who use it on a regular rhythm and not only at launch.
* Before a new agent is built, study how teams do that work today, so the agent is designed around how the work is done.
* Find out whether each agent improves the work it supports, for example whether Epics and Features meet the quality standard and whether teams arrive at stage gates prepared, as well as whether people find it easy to use.
* Test with users across CFUs, so that findings do not rest on one group alone.
* Include people who tried an agent and stopped using it, and people who have not started, as well as regular users.
* Repeat the same tasks with users after a change has been made, and report whether the behaviour observed has changed.
* When shared on Wayfinder, are users able to find the information.
* Work with the Designer on discoverability of the Delivery Standards published including the agents and other guidelines.

**Observation and research practice**

* Observe people using the agents in their real work, and record what they did separately from what they said they did.
* Invite agent owners to watch sessions and to take part in making sense of what was seen, so the people who act on the findings have seen the evidence themselves.
* Support demonstrations and user sessions run by colleagues and show them how to observe without leading the user.
* Insight and recommendations
* Write up a report covering what was observed, what it means, how strong the evidence is, and a ranked set of recommendations. Agent owners decide what to act on and make the changes.
* Maintain record of findings across all agents, so that patterns and recurring needs across agents are visible.

**Data protection, consent and research ethics**

* Handle research data in line with BT data protection, consent and regulatory requirements, including participant privacy.
* Make sure research findings are never used to judge an individual’s performance, and tell participants this before each session.

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* Strong observation skill: you can describe a session so that someone who was not there understands what happened and why it matters.
* Experience planning and running moderated usability sessions and interviews from start to finish.
* Experience agreeing research questions with stakeholders and choosing the method that fits each question, including saying when a question does not need new research.
* Experience studying how people work before a product is designed, as well as testing products already in use.
* Experience turning observations into clear recommendations, written in plain language for senior stakeholders.
* Experience researching with enterprise users within data protection and compliance constraints.
* Three or more years of experience as a user researcher.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**

* Experience testing AI assistants, copilots or other AI-enabled workflow tools.
* Experience involving product owners and developers in observing sessions and analysing findings.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence and SharePoint as used by delivery teams.

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
  
  
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
  
  
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
  
  
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: Lead UX Research
description:
**Job Title**
Lead UX Research
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Principal UX Researcher, AI Experiences will guide research and experience strategy for reusable AI capabilities across Amadeus Business Lines.
  
  
Working collaboratively with Product, Design, Engineering, and Architecture teams, you’ll help shape how users understand, trust, and interact with AI-powered systems. Areas of focus include explainability, confidence, AI monitoring, Human-in-the-Loop controls, agent activity, and responsible AI.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor position that blends practical design judgment, applied UX research expertise, and an understanding of AI technology.
  
  
**In This Role, You’ll**
AI Experience Research
  
  

* Drive research for complex AI-powered products and platforms.
* Explore user expectations around AI transparency, trust, control, and monitoring.
* Develop research strategies using interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing, and concept validation.
* Translate insights into actionable design principles and product recommendations.
* Evaluate AI experiences across conversational, operational, API-enabled, and multi-channel workflows.

Experience Strategy & Design
  
  

* Shape the experience vision for capabilities like explainability, monitoring, Human-in-the-Loop, and agent orchestration.
* Define how AI decisions, confidence levels, progress, and exceptions are presented to different users.
* Collaborate with UX Designers to develop journeys, prototypes, and validated interaction patterns.
* Balance usability with technical, security, and privacy considerations.
* Help establish reusable AI experience patterns for adoption across teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with Product Managers, AI Engineers, and Business Lines to identify shared experience needs.
* Facilitate workshops to align research, design, and priorities.
* Bring user evidence into product planning and capability discussions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify direction in evolving AI problem spaces.
* Contribute to mentoring and continuous learning across UX and AI communities.

Your Profile
  
  

* Typically brings over a decade of experience in UX research, experience design, or human-centered product development.
* Significant experience in enterprise or platform environments.
* Practical exposure to AI-powered experiences (Generative AI, Agentic AI, etc.).
* Experience leading or shaping research strategy across products.
* Understanding of trust, explainability, automation, and responsible AI principles.
* Ability to translate insights into user experience direction.
* Working knowledge of tools like Figma, Miro, or similar.
* Strong facilitation, storytelling, and communication abilities.
* Comfortable working in dynamic, ambiguous or emerging domains.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Hands-on UX or interaction design experience.
* Experience designing dashboards, monitoring tools, or decision-support systems.
* Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and confidence indicators.
* Awareness of accessibility, data visualization, and multi-channel experience design.
* Experience with AI governance, privacy, or regulatory frameworks.
* Understanding of domains such as travel, payments, or enterprise solutions.

Success in this Role
  
  
You’ll help build a research-driven experience framework for reusable AI capabilities—enabling Amadeus Business Lines to deliver AI products that are clear, trustworthy, and easy to operate. Your work ensures that core AI experiences reflect real user needs and support adoption at scale.
  
  
Organization: AI Delivery Hub
  
  
Experience: Typically 14+ years or equivalent experience in human-centered product development
  
  
Role Type: Senior individual contributor and cross-team UX leader
  
  
Primary Focus: UX research, experience strategy, and reusable AI interaction patterns
  
  
What we can offer you
  
  
🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
  
🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
  
🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
  
🌟 A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
  
🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
  
📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
  
🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.
